nom: Envy Hyaluronic Acid & Salicylic Acid Face Scrub - Anti-Aging

avis.texte: It looks and smells like shampoo. It may very well be good for my face, it didnt make me.breakout or anything and left it smooth, but the fragrance and feel is too much like.something I put on my hair. Im considering using it as a body wash.

This facial cleanser is fantastic! My daughter bought it for me and I fell in love. It helps close large pores, removes makeup easily and smells like a million bucks! You gotta try it. Your face will love you for it.
Leaves my face feeling fresh and smells great. Very gentle on my sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Can see it working when using it. Good product
avis.texte: It’s not gritty like most exfoliants. It’s more like just a cleanser but it works very good and I will buy more when I run out
It really isn’t a SCRUB. It’s a cleanser. But it works well. Great size. Like the salicylic acid in it.
Smell good, leaves skin feeling nice and soft, reasonably priced. I would buy it again.

avis.titre: Helps clear problem skin without overdryingHelps clear problem skin without overdrying
avis.texte: I love the product. Ive recently started having menopausal/hormonal breakouts and it really helps clear them up without totally drying my skin out like acne products made for younger people. I know it seems kind of silly, but the only reason I gave it a lower score is that the bottle itself looks like it has been through a wringer. The plastic tube is very beat up, has deep creases, scrapes & scratches like it was run over & drug on the ground. I dont know what happened to it prior to its arrival.
Lo acabo de probar y me gusta que la piel queda muy suave !!! Me lo recomendó mi mejor amiga que es esteticista y maquilladora profesional 💙

I love this so much I bought it for both of my daughters. Even after the first use there's a difference. Soft,smooth,clearer,brown spots are slowly fading. For every day or once a week,what ever works for you. Great stuff!
I love this product. It leaves my face clean without drying it out.

This review is for an Envy brand Facial Scrub with Hyaluronic Acid & Salicylic Acid This seems to be a great facial wash scrub in a good sized bottle. Fresh mild clean smell. Seems to go well with my normally sensitive skin. May be a new favorite. Apply a nickle sized amount to your wet skin, gently scrub in a circular motion and rinse. Non foaming, just a clean wash. Leaves my face feeling fresh and clean. Good clean ingredients such as Vitamin E, Salicylic Acid, Glycerin, and hyaluronic acid. Seems to be lots of additional goodness in this great face scrub wash such as : ethically sourced, 100% clean ingredients, hypoallergenic, non GMO, paraben and phthalate free. As well as natural, vegan and cruelty free. An all around clean face wash scrub that leaves your face feeling fresh and clean.

avis.titre: Good cleanser, but not really a scrub
avis.texte: I’m used to something called a ‘scrub’ as having those course little beads that exfoliate your skin. This doesn’t do that, but it is nonetheless a really good facial wash, and on that alone I still recommend it highly. I’m not going to repeat all the market points the seller already makes, but the chemicals seem to strike a nice balance with stripping excess oil from my oily skin as needed without leaving it devoid of all moisture. Not all cleansers can hit that sweet spot, but this works pretty well.
